Affected by target's Evasion.

skillcritical.descripcion:
Attacking with a skill has a chance to deal a critical hit.
Affected by target's Skill Critical Hit Resist.

skillcriticalresist.descripcion: Reduces target's Skill Critical Hit Rate when attacked.

skilldefense.descripcion:
Defense against Skill Attack.
Reduces Skill Damage taken.

skillevasion.descripcion: Evading skills prevents damage. Max Evasion rate is 30%.

sleepaccuracy.descripcion: Increases the chance of landing Sleep skills by a certain rate.

sleepresist.descripcion: Reduces the target's chance of landing Sleep skills by a certain rate.

slowaccuracy.descripcion: Increases the chance of landing Lethargy skills by a certain rate.

slowresist.descripcion: Reduces the target's chance of landing Lethargy skills by a certain rate.

snareaccuracy.descripcion: Increases the chance of landing Slow skills by a certain rate.

snareresist.descripcion: Reduces the target's chance of landing Slow skills by a certain rate.

space.descripcion:
Space [Israphel]
Increases Move Speed and Block Chance.

spmax.descripcion:
Consumed when sprinting or evading.
Applies when sprinting normally or while riding a pet.

stoneaccuracy.descripcion: Increases the chance of landing Petrify skills by a certain rate.

stoneresist.descripcion: Reduces the target's chance of landing Petrify skills by a certain rate.

stunaccuracy.descripcion: Increases the chance of landing Stun skills by a certain rate.

stunresist.descripcion: Reduces the target's chance of landing Stun skills by a certain rate.

swimmingmagicdamage.descripcion: Increases Magic Damage when attacking underwater.

swimmingphysicdamage.descripcion: Increases Physical Damage when attacking underwater.

swimmingsprintcost.descripcion: Reduces Stamina Cost when swimming fast.

tauntaccuracy.descripcion: Increases the chance of landing Taunt skills by a certain rate.

tauntresist.descripcion: Reduces the target's chance of landing Taunt skills by a certain rate.

time.descripcion:
Time [Siel]
Increases Combat Speed and Double Resist.

transaccuracy.descripcion:
Accuracy added when attacking Varian.
Offset by the Varian's Evasion and Block.

transamplifydamage.descripcion:
Boosts Damage when attacking Varian.
Affected by target's Varian Damage Tolerance.

transblock.descripcion: Increases Block Chance when attacked by Varian.

transblockpierce.descripcion: Ignores Varian Block Chance when attacking Varian.

transcritical.descripcion: Increases Critical Hit Rate when attacking Varian.

transcriticalresist.descripcion: Reduces Critical Hit Rate when attacked by Varian.

transdecreasedamage.descripcion: Weakens Damage taken when attacked by Varian.

transevasion.descripcion: Increases chance to evade incoming attacks when attacked by Varian.

vehiclespeed.descripcion: Basic Move Speed while riding a pet.

vehiclesprintcost.nombre: Mount Sprint Stamina Cost Reduction Rate
vehiclesprintcost.descripcion: Reduces Stamina consumed when sprinting while riding a pet.

vehiclesprintspeed.descripcion: Increases Move Speed when sprinting while riding a pet.

weaponaccuracy.descripcion:
Prevents attack from missing.
Offset by target's Evasion and Block.

weaponblock.descripcion:
Increases Parry Chance.
Affected by target's Accuracy and Block Penetration.
※ Block Damage Reduction Rate varies based on Gear Grade.

weaponblockdefense.descripcion: Reduces more Damage when Parry activates.

weapondamage.descripcion:
Max Attack of the weapon.
Perfect scales with Max Attack.

weaponfixingdamage.descripcion:
Basic Attack.
Higher Attack deals more damage.

wisdom.descripcion:
Wisdom [Lumiel]
Reduces MP Consumption and increases Double Chance.
